"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Checkbox as CheckboxPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/checkbox" import { Icon } from "@iconify/react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" // Ledger Light Checkbox — when checked it becomes a small blue chip that reuses // the primary Button's exact material (rim + soft blue glow), scaled to 16px. // Base UI className can be a state function; the wrapper feeds it to cn(), so // narrow it to a plain string (same treatment as the other ported files). type WithClassName

= Omit & { className?: string } const Checkbox = React.forwardRef< React.ElementRef, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) Checkbox.displayName = "Checkbox" export { Checkbox }
